_doc: Spire moth (act3/spire_moth.md): the flue moth's slots, glassy and pale. fur: bone into lit_ceramic (vertex colour), no embers, so no emission; wing: salt_glass forewings and gauze_white hindwings, glossy, low roughness, high specular and a strong rim sheen so they read as glass and the flare catches the light (the glint is battle VFX), not emissive; eye: black and wet, as the base; wound: the base's one small closed spawn_wound mark seared across its brow, the weak point (ADR 0151). No glimmer: it is a beast (creatures README rule 3). write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
